title: mcpvet settings (.mcpvetrc.json)
description: Project settings. JSONC (comments and trailing commas) is accepted. Command-line flags take precedence over this file.

failOn.description: Lowest severity that produces exit code 1.

minSeverity.description: Findings below this severity are not reported at all.

ignore.description: Rule ids to skip. Prefer a comment in the pull request explaining why.

baseline.description: Path to the accepted-findings file. Omit the file to run without a baseline.

descriptors.description: tools/list JSON files to audit alongside the configs.
